== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Liquid [[steel]] is a powerful substance that can be summoned or drawn upon from [[Valinhall]] to provide physical enhancements. When utilized, it manifests as a rushing, icy sensation within the veins and muscles, acting like a freezing torrent or waterfall. This essence provides the user with immense strength and speed while simultaneously alleviating feelings of pain and physical weakness. The sensation is often described as a cold power that can make a person feel capable of incredible feats of [[destruction]]. Users may choose to draw this power out gradually or summon it all at once, though the latter can lead to a more rapid depletion of energy. Additionally, liquid [[steel]] can be stored in vials and summoned through mental focus on its image.}}
